theme_preservation: Keep existing company theme from /app/frontend/src/theme.ts. Use lime (#76EC00), forest (#174D37) for highlights, and cityFade for pastel backgrounds.

typography.headings: Bold sans-serif with tight tracking (React Native text styling).

visual_enhancers.3D_bags: Use 3D bag assets with gradient backgrounds for the Shop by Store categories.
visual_enhancers.add_to_cart: Lottie popup or Animated scale-in overlay when adding to cart.
visual_enhancers.scrollaway_header: Animated.View tied to scroll offset to hide top categories and show search bar.
visual_enhancers.theme_animations: Indian festival animations (Navratri/Ganesh) for Festive Time, powerful dull animation for Fitness.

components.name: ShopByStore
components.description: Horizontal or grid section showing the 5 themed stores with 3D bag icons.

components.name: StoreCategoryCard
components.description: Card with 3D bag and items inside, placed on gradient background.

components.name: CompactProductCard
components.description: Smaller items catalog to show more on screen.

components.name: PersistentBottomNav
components.description: Bottom navigation bar that stays constant throughout the app.

layouts.categories_grid: Compact 3-column or 4-column grid for categories to fit more on screen.
layouts.scroll_behavior: Make Home screen and Categories scrollable.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a back button on every inner page header for easier navigation.
Design a Categories page inspired by Instamart, emphasizing tight spacing and small components.
Implement 'Shop by Store' with 5 themed categories: Festive time, Fitness and Sport, Trending in market, Gourmet Treats, Everyday Essentials.
For 'Shop by Store', use 3D bag icons displaying items inside, layered on gradient backgrounds.
Animate the scroll view: Top categories (Food, Groceries, Pharmacy, Beauty) must scroll away (hide), and a search bar must remain or appear.
Make product cards more compact (smaller items catalog) to fit more items on the screen.
Make the home screen and Categories pages scrollable.
Add-to-cart action should trigger a creative pop-up animation.
Ensure bottom navigation stays constant throughout the app. Use a Tab Navigator structure or place it outside individual screen stacks.
Reload all missing icons and illustrations throughout the app to fix missing images.
Apply specific themed animations when clicking 'Shop by Store' categories: Ganesh Chaturthi/Navratri style for Festive time, and a dull-colored powerful animation for Fitness and Sport.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds under text or icons without a blur or solid color.
Use React Native Animated or Reanimated for smooth scroll-away headers.
